info.description: Real-time chat API with conversations, messages, reactions, and presence.
info.title: Modami Chat Service

get.description: Returns the caller's conversations ordered by most-recently updated.

post.description: Opens a 1-to-1 conversation with another user. Idempotent: returns the existing conversation if one already exists.
post.summary: Create or get a direct chat

post.description: Creates a new group chat. The caller is added as admin. Requires at least 1 additional member (max 49).

get.description: Returns a single conversation. The caller must be a member.
Returns messages ordered newest-first. Use the returned cursor for pagination. The caller must be a member.

post.description: Sends a message to a conversation. The caller must be a member. Subject to per-user rate limiting.

403.description: Not a member or admin-only conversation

post.description: Adds a user to a group conversation. Requires admin role. Max group size is 50.
post.summary: Add a participant to a group

409.description: Already a member or group is full

delete.description: Removes a user from a group. An admin can remove any member; a member can remove themselves (leave).
delete.summary: Remove a participant from a group

post.description: Updates the caller's read cursor to the given message. Clears the unread count for this conversation.
Broadcasts a typing event to other conversation members via Centrifugo.

put.description: Updates the text of a message. Only the original sender may edit. Only text messages can be edited.

delete.description: Soft-deletes a message (content is cleared; the record remains). Only the original sender may delete.

post.description: Reacts to a message with an emoji. A message may have at most 20 distinct emojis and 50 users per emoji.

delete.description: Removes the caller's reaction with the given emoji from a message.

get.description: Returns a map of conversation_id → unread_count for the caller. Counts are served from Redis cache.

media.description: Media attachment. Required when type != text.

mentions.description: Optional list of mentioned user IDs.

text.description: Plain text body. Required when type=text.

type.description: Message type: text, image, video, file, or audio.
